san_generation_contract.description: 约束大模型基于本 schema 生成 San 组件时必须满足的条件。
must_preserve: metadata.component_name 和根节点语义
template.dom_tree 的层级结构、节点顺序与语义角色
template.component_refs 中每个子组件的注册名和父子通信事件
binding_graph 中 data/props/computed 到模板节点的可见绑定
event_model 中每个 DOM 事件和自定义事件的触发时机与 payload
style_model 中动态类名、动态样式、scoped CSS 和关键视觉状态
script.options.lifecycle_hooks 中的副作用初始化与清理逻辑
script.options.data 中所有字段的默认值和外部初始化来源
quality_checks: template.component_refs 中每个子组件都在 script.components 或 san_registration 中有定义
binding_graph.edges 中每条 template 依赖都能在 script.options 中找到来源
event_model.dom_events 中每个 handler_name 都存在于 script.options.methods
event_model.custom_events 中每个 emit_points 都对应 method 中的 $emit 调用
style_model.dynamic_class_bindings 的 dependencies 都存在于 binding_graph.nodes
script.options.watch 中的 deep watcher 在 migration_hints 中被标记并给出替代策略
san_syntax_requirements: 输出完整的 .san 单文件组件，包含 <template>、<script>、<style> 三个代码块；若无样式也保留空 style 或显式说明无样式
脚本块显式引入 san：const san = require('san')，并使用 module.exports = san.defineComponent(...) 导出组件
props 使用 san.DataTypes 声明，与 script.options.props 一一对应；优先输出 DataTypes.number / string / bool / array / object
组件定义使用 san.defineComponent
组件名来自 metadata.component_name，并显式输出 name 字段
data 使用 initData 返回默认值，与 script.options.data 一一对应；不要在 initData 中直接依赖复杂运行时读取
当 data 字段来源于 props 或外部初始化时，优先在 inited/attached 中用 this.data.set 完成同步
模板中使用 s-if、s-for、on-event、value={= =}、checked={= =} 等 San 语法
状态访问统一使用 this.data.get() / this.data.set()
优先将 methods 直接定义在组件对象顶层，避免保留 Vue 风格的 methods: {} 包裹
子组件标签使用短横线命名
子组件在 components 中显式注册
样式块需尽量完整输出，优先复用 styles/style_model 中已有 class 与 css_rules 信息
定时器、timeout、外部监听等副作用在 attached/disposed 中管理

repair_result.repair_prompt:
你是一个 Vue 到 San 迁移修复专家。请根据 SSM、当前 San 代码和校验报告，修复 San 单文件组件。
修复目标：输出必须满足下面列出的 San 结构、语法和渲染一致性规则；不要只生成语义上看起来像 San 的代码。

输出要求：
1. 只输出完整 .san 文件内容，不要输出解释、标题或 Markdown 代码围栏。
2. 必须包含 <template>、<script>、<style> 三段。
3. <script> 中必须使用 const san = require('san')、const DataTypes = san.DataTypes、module.exports = san.defineComponent(...)。
4. Vue props 必须迁移为 San dataTypes，禁止在 san.defineComponent 中输出 props: {...}。
5. initData() 只能返回稳定默认数据对象；Vue props 的 default（包括数组/对象工厂默认值）必须作为同名字段落入 initData；Vue data() 的全部初始值必须精确等价地保留，包括嵌套对象、数组、数字和启用项集合，不得用空字符串、空数组或删减后的集合替代；如果内部 data 依赖 props，必须在 inited() 中用 this.data.get('propName') 读取并 this.data.set(...) 同步。
6. 组件状态读写必须使用 this.data.get('field') 和 this.data.set('field', value)；San computed 的结果也在 data store 中，computed 之间的依赖以及普通方法读取 computed 时必须使用 this.data.get('computedName')，禁止 this.computed.foo()；Vue 的 this.$emit(...) 或 emitEvent 包装方法必须迁移为 this.fire(...)，禁止 this.props、this.xxx 状态读写、this.$emit 和用 this.dispatch(...) 代替自定义事件。
7. 方法必须直接定义在 san.defineComponent 顶层，禁止保留 Vue 的 methods: {...} 包裹。
8. template 必须使用 San 语法：on-click、s-if、s-for；保留事件调用的全部参数，例如 on-click="move(-1)"、on-click="select(task.id)"；Vue v-for 的 :key 必须写入 s-for 的 trackby 子句，例如 s-for="task in tasks trackby task.id"，禁止输出独立 key="{{ task.id }}" 或 key="{= task.id =}"；所有 {{ ... }} 和 {= ... =} 插值必须完整闭合；双向绑定 {= assignable.path =} 只能用于可赋值的数据路径，方法调用、computed 表达式和其他派生值必须使用单向插值；disabled、checked、selected 等派生属性必须使用 disabled="{{ expression }}" 这一类单向插值，禁止写成 disabled="{= expression =}"；方法调用、computed 表达式和其他派生值必须使用单向插值，例如 checked="{{ isEnabled(rule.id, enabled) }}"；禁止丢失参数、使用 data-args/getAttribute 绕行，或保留 @click、v-if、v-for、v-model、:class 等 Vue 模板语法。
9. style 标签必须写成 <style>，禁止输出 <style scoped>；必须保留原有 class 名和样式内容。
10. 不要重新设计组件，不要引入外部依赖，不要删除已有 DOM 节点、文本、class 或样式。
11. 如果 DOM 对比报告指出缺失/新增/变化节点，优先修复 template 结构。
12. 补充要求：优先修复 validate 与 visual_eval 报告中指出的问题，保持原有 DOM 结构、文本、class 和样式。

修复前请按下面清单自检，但最终不要输出清单：
- 是否存在 props:、methods:、this.props、this.$emit、this.dispatch、<style scoped>、@click、v-if、v-for、v-model、:class？如果存在，必须改掉。
- SSM props 是否全部出现在 dataTypes 中？
- 带 default 的 Vue props 是否以同名字段和等价默认值出现在 initData 中？
- Vue data() 中每个初始值是否精确保留了原始类型、嵌套内容、数组元素和数值，而不是空值或删减值？
- computed 之间以及普通方法中是否只通过 this.data.get('computedName') 读取 computed，且完全不存在 this.computed.foo()？
- 所有 {= ... =} 是否都是可赋值数据路径；disabled、checked、selected 等派生属性是否使用 {{ ... }} 单向插值；方法调用和 computed 等派生表达式是否使用 {{ ... }} 单向插值？
- 所有 {{ ... }} 和 {= ... =} 是否完整闭合；Vue v-for 的 :key 是否迁移为 s-for 内联 trackby，且不存在独立 key 属性？
- 事件绑定中的参数是否完整保留，且没有 data-args/getAttribute 绕行？
- SSM data 字段是否全部在 initData 或 this.data.set 中有对应？
- SSM 事件 handler 是否同时在 template 的 on-* 和 script 顶层方法中存在？

        "content": ".expense-tracker {\n  max-width: 550px;\n  margin: 40px auto;\n  padding: 24px;\n  background: #ffffff;\n  border-radius: 20px;\n  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\n  transition: all 0.3s;\n  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;\n}\n\n.expense-tracker.dark-mode {\n  background: #1e293b;\n  color: #e2e8f0;\n}\n\n/* 头部 */\n.header {\n  display: flex;\n  justify-content: space-between;\n  align-items: center;\n  margin-bottom: 24px;\n}\n\n.header h2 {\n  margin: 0;\n}\n\n.theme-btn {\n  padding: 8px 16px;\n  background: #f1f5f9;\n  border: none;\n  border-radius: 10px;\n  cursor: pointer;\n  font-size: 16px;\n}\n\n.dark-mode .theme-btn {\n  background: #334155;\n}\n\n/* 余额卡片 */\n.balance-card {\n  display: flex;\n  gap: 16px;\n  margin-bottom: 24px;\n  padding: 16px;\n  background: #f8fafc;\n  border-radius: 16px;\n}\n\n.dark-mode .balance-card {\n  background: #0f172a;\n}\n\n.balance-item {\n  flex: 1;\n  text-align: center;\n}\n\n.balance-label {\n  display: block;\n  font-size: 12px;\n  color: #64748b;\n  margin-bottom: 8px;\n}\n\n.balance-value {\n  display: block;\n  font-size: 20px;\n  font-weight: 700;\n}\n\n.balance-value.income {\n  color: #10b981;\n}\n\n.balance-value.expense {\n  color: #ef4444;\n}\n\n.balance-value.positive {\n  color: #10b981;\n}\n\n.balance-value.negative {\n  color: #ef4444;\n}\n\n/* 添加表单 */\n.add-form {\n  display: flex;\n  gap: 8px;\n  margin-bottom: 24px;\n  flex-wrap: wrap;\n}\n\n.add-form select,\n.add-form input {\n  padding: 10px 12px;\n  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;\n  border-radius: 10px;\n  font-size: 14px;\n  background: white;\n}\n\n.dark-mode .add-form select,\n.dark-mode .add-form input {\n  background: #0f172a;\n  border-color: #334155;\n  color: #e2e8f0;\n}\n\n.add-form select {\n  width: 80px;\n}\n\n.add-form input:first-of-type {\n  width: 100px;\n}\n\n.add-form input:last-of-type {\n  width: 120px;\n}\n\n.add-form button {\n  padding: 10px 20px;\n  background: #3b82f6;\n  color: white;\n  border: none;\n  border-radius: 10px;\n  cursor: pointer;\n  font-weight: 600;\n}\n\n/* 筛选栏 */\n.filter-bar {\n  display: flex;\n  gap: 12px;\n  margin-bottom: 20px;\n  flex-wrap: wrap;\n}\n\n.filter-bar select {\n  padding: 8px 12px;\n  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;\n  border-radius: 10px;\n  background: white;\n  cursor: pointer;\n}\n\n.dark-mode .filter-bar select {\n  background: #0f172a;\n  border-color: #334155;\n  color: #e2e8f0;\n}\n\n.clear-filter {\n  padding: 8px 16px;\n  background: #f1f5f9;\n  border: none;\n  border-radius: 10px;\n  cursor: pointer;\n  font-size: 12px;\n}\n\n/* 图表区域 */\n.chart-section {\n  margin-bottom: 24px;\n  padding: 16px;\n  background: #f8fafc;\n  border-radius: 16px;\n}\n\n.dark-mode .chart-section {\n  background: #0f172a;\n}\n\n.chart-section h3 {\n  margin: 0 0 16px 0;\n  font-size: 14px;\n}\n\n.chart-bars {\n  display: flex;\n  flex-direction: column;\n  gap: 12px;\n}\n\n.chart-item {\n  display: flex;\n  align-items: center;\n  gap: 12px;\n  font-size: 12px;\n}\n\n.chart-label {\n  width: 50px;\n  font-weight: 500;\n}\n\n.bar-container {\n  flex: 1;\n  display: flex;\n  align-items: center;\n  gap: 8px;\n}\n\n.bar {\n  height: 8px;\n  background: #3b82f6;\n  border-radius: 4px;\n  transition: width 0.3s;\n}\n\n.bar-value {\n  font-size: 12px;\n  color: #64748b;\n  min-width: 45px;\n}\n\n/* 记录列表 */\n.records-list {\n  margin-bottom: 16px;\n  max-height: 350px;\n  overflow-y: auto;\n}\n\n.record-item {\n  display: flex;\n  justify-content: space-between;\n  align-items: center;\n  padding: 12px;\n  margin-bottom: 8px;\n  background: #f8fafc;\n  border-radius: 12px;\n  transition: all 0.2s;\n}\n\n.dark-mode .record-item {\n  background: #0f172a;\n}\n\n.record-item.income {\n  border-left: 4px solid #10b981;\n}\n\n.record-item.expense {\n  border-left: 4px solid #ef4444;\n}\n\n.record-info {\n  flex: 1;\n}\n\n.record-category {\n  display: block;\n  font-weight: 500;\n  font-size: 14px;\n  margin-bottom: 4px;\n}\n\n.record-date {\n  font-size: 11px;\n  color: #94a3b8;\n}\n\n.record-amount {\n  font-weight: 700;\n  font-size: 16px;\n}\n\n.record-amount.income {\n  color: #10b981;\n}\n\n.record-amount.expense {\n  color: #ef4444;\n}\n\n.delete-btn {\n  padding: 4px 12px;\n  background: #fee2e2;\n  color: #ef4444;\n  border: none;\n  border-radius: 8px;\n  cursor: pointer;\n  font-size: 12px;\n  margin-left: 12px;\n}\n\n.dark-mode .delete-btn {\n  background: #450a0a;\n}\n\n.empty-state {\n  text-align: center;\n  padding: 40px;\n  color: #94a3b8;\n}\n\n/* 底部 */\n.footer {\n  display: flex;\n  justify-content: space-between;\n  align-items: center;\n  padding-top: 16px;\n  border-top: 1px solid #e2e8f0;\n  font-size: 13px;\n}\n\n.dark-mode .footer {\n  border-top-color: #334155;\n}\n\n.clear-all {\n  padding: 6px 12px;\n  background: #f1f5f9;\n  border: none;\n  border-radius: 8px;\n  cursor: pointer;\n  font-size: 12px;\n}\n\n.dark-mode .clear-all {\n  background: #334155;\n  color: #e2e8f0;\n}\n\n/* 响应式 */\n@media (max-width: 500px) {\n  .expense-tracker {\n    margin: 20px;\n    padding: 16px;\n  }\n  \n  .balance-card {\n    flex-direction: column;\n    gap: 12px;\n  }\n  \n  .add-form {\n    flex-direction: column;\n  }\n  \n  .add-form select,\n  .add-form input,\n  .add-form button {\n    width: 100%;\n  }\n}",

<template>
<div class="expense-tracker" class="{{isDarkMode ? 'dark-mode' : ''}}">
  <div class="header">
    <h2>💰 记账本</h2>
    <button class="theme-btn" on-click="toggleTheme">{{isDarkMode ? '☀️' : '🌙'}}</button>
  </div>

  <div class="balance-card">
    <div class="balance-item">
      <span class="balance-label">总收入</span>
      <span class="balance-value income">+¥{{totalIncome}}</span>
    </div>
    <div class="balance-item">
      <span class="balance-label">总支出</span>
      <span class="balance-value expense">-¥{{totalExpense}}</span>
    </div>
    <div class="balance-item">
      <span class="balance-label">结余</span>
      <span class="balance-value" class="{{balance >= 0 ? 'positive' : 'negative'}}">¥{{balance}}</span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="add-form">
    <select value="{= newType =}">
      <option value="income">收入</option>
      <option value="expense">支出</option>
    </select>
    <input type="number" placeholder="金额" value="{= newAmount =}" on-keyup.enter="addRecord" />
    <input type="text" placeholder="分类" value="{= newCategory =}" on-keyup.enter="addRecord" />
    <button on-click="addRecord">添加</button>
  </div>

  <div class="filter-bar">
    <select value="{= filterType =}">
      <option value="all">全部</option>
      <option value="income">收入</option>
      <option value="expense">支出</option>
    </select>
    <select value="{= filterCategory =}">
      <option value="all">全部分类</option>
      <option s-for="cat in categories" value="{{cat}}">{{cat}}</option>
    </select>
    <button class="clear-filter" s-if="hasFilter" on-click="clearFilter">清除</button>
  </div>

  <div class="chart-section" s-if="expenseByCategory.length > 0">
    <h3>支出分类统计</h3>
    <div class="chart-bars">
      <div class="chart-item" s-for="item in expenseByCategory trackby item.category">
        <span class="chart-label">{{item.category}}</span>
        <div class="bar-container">
          <div class="bar" style="{{'width: ' + getBarWidth(item.amount) + '%'}}"></div>
          <span class="bar-value">¥{{item.amount}}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="records-list">
    <div class="record-item" s-for="record in filteredRecords trackby record.id" class="{{record.type}}">
      <div class="record-info">
        <span class="record-category">{{record.category}}</span>
        <span class="record-date">{{formatDate(record.date)}}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="record-amount" class="{{record.type}}">{{record.type === 'income' ? '+' : '-'}}¥{{record.amount}}</div>
      <button class="delete-btn" on-click="deleteRecord(record.id)">删除</button>
    </div>
    <div class="empty-state" s-if="filteredRecords.length === 0">暂无记录，添加一笔吧</div>
  </div>

  <div class="footer" s-if="records.length > 0">
    <span>共{{filteredRecords.length}}条记录</span>
    <button class="clear-all" on-click="clearAll">清空全部</button>
  </div>
</template>

<script>
const san = require('san');
const DataTypes = san.DataTypes;

module.exports = san.defineComponent({
  name: 'ExpenseTracker',

  dataTypes: {
    isDarkMode: DataTypes.bool,
    records: DataTypes.array,
    newType: DataTypes.string,
    newAmount: DataTypes.string,
    newCategory: DataTypes.string,
    filterType: DataTypes.string,
    filterCategory: DataTypes.string
  },

  initData() {
    return {
      isDarkMode: false,
      records: [],
      newType: 'expense',
      newAmount: '',
      newCategory: '',
      filterType: 'all',
      filterCategory: 'all'
    };
  },

  inited() {
    this.loadFromLocal();
  },

  computed: {
    totalIncome() {
      return this.data.get('records')
        .filter(r => r.type === 'income')
        .reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.amount, 0);
    },

    totalExpense() {
      return this.data.get('records')
        .filter(r => r.type === 'expense')
        .reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.amount, 0);
    },

    balance() {
      return this.data.get('totalIncome') - this.data.get('totalExpense');
    },

    categories() {
      const records = this.data.get('records');
      const cats = [...new Set(records.map(r => r.category))];
      return cats.sort();
    },

    expenseByCategory() {
      const records = this.data.get('records');
      const categoryMap = new Map();
      records
        .filter(r => r.type === 'expense')
        .forEach(r => {
          const current = categoryMap.get(r.category) || 0;
          categoryMap.set(r.category, current + r.amount);
        });
      return Array.from(categoryMap.entries())
        .map(([category, amount]) => ({ category, amount }))
        .sort((a, b) => b.amount - a.amount);
    },

    maxExpenseAmount() {
      const expenseByCategory = this.data.get('expenseByCategory');
      if (expenseByCategory.length === 0) return 0;
      return Math.max(...expenseByCategory.map(item => item.amount));
    },

    filteredRecords() {
      let result = [...this.data.get('records')];

      if (this.data.get('filterType') !== 'all') {
        result = result.filter(r => r.type === this.data.get('filterType'));
      }

      if (this.data.get('filterCategory') !== 'all') {
        result = result.filter(r => r.category === this.data.get('filterCategory'));
      }

      return result.sort((a, b) => b.date - a.date);
    },

    hasFilter() {
      return this.data.get('filterType') !== 'all' || this.data.get('filterCategory') !== 'all';
    }
  },

  addRecord() {
    const amount = parseFloat(this.data.get('newAmount'));
    if (isNaN(amount) || amount <= 0) {
      alert('请输入有效的金额');
      return;
    }
    if (!this.data.get('newCategory').trim()) {
      alert('请输入分类');
      return;
    }

    const newRecord = {
      id: Date.now(),
      type: this.data.get('newType'),
      amount: amount,
      category: this.data.get('newCategory').trim(),
      date: Date.now()
    };

    const records = this.data.get('records');
    records.push(newRecord);
    this.data.set('records', records);

    this.data.set('newAmount', '');
    this.data.set('newCategory', '');
    this.saveToLocal();
  },

  deleteRecord(id) {
    const records = this.data.get('records').filter(r => r.id !== id);
    this.data.set('records', records);
    this.saveToLocal();
  },

  clearAll() {
    if (confirm('确定要清空所有记录吗？')) {
      this.data.set('records', []);
      this.saveToLocal();
    }
  },

  clearFilter() {
    this.data.set('filterType', 'all');
    this.data.set('filterCategory', 'all');
  },

  getBarWidth(amount) {
    const maxExpenseAmount = this.data.get('maxExpenseAmount');
    if (maxExpenseAmount === 0) return 0;
    return (amount / maxExpenseAmount) * 100;
  },

  formatDate(timestamp) {
    const date = new Date(timestamp);
    const now = new Date();
    const today = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());
    const yesterday = new Date(today - 86400000);

    if (timestamp >= today) {
      return `今天 ${date.getHours()}:${String(date.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
    } else if (timestamp >= yesterday) {
      return '昨天';
    } else {
      return `${date.getMonth() + 1}/${date.getDate()}`;
    }
  },

  toggleTheme() {
    this.data.set('isDarkMode', !this.data.get('isDarkMode'));
  },

  saveToLocal() {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('expense_records', JSON.stringify(this.data.get('records')));
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Failed to save to localStorage:', e);
    }
  },

  loadFromLocal() {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem('expense_records');
      if (saved) {
        try {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(saved);
          this.data.set('records', this.normalizeRecords(parsed));
        } catch (e) {
          this.data.set('records', this.getSampleRecords());
        }
      } else {
        this.data.set('records', this.getSampleRecords());
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Failed to load from localStorage:', e);
      this.data.set('records', this.getSampleRecords());
    }
  },

  normalizeRecords(records) {
    if (!Array.isArray(records)) {
      return this.getSampleRecords();
    }

    return records
      .map((record, index) => {
        if (!record || typeof record !== 'object') {
          return null;
        }

        const type = record.type === 'income' ? 'income' : (record.type === 'expense' ? 'expense' : null);
        const amount = Number(record.amount);
        const category = typeof record.category === 'string' ? record.category.trim() : '';
        const date = Number(record.date);
        const id = record.id != null ? record.id : Date.now() + index;

        if (!type || !Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0 || !category || !Number.isFinite(date)) {
          return null;
        }

        return { id, type, amount, category, date };
      })
      .filter(Boolean);
  },

  getSampleRecords() {
    const now = Date.now();
    return [
      { id: 1, type: 'income', amount: 5000, category: '工资', date: now - 2 * 86400000 },
      { id: 2, type: 'expense', amount: 68, category: '餐饮', date: now - 1 * 86400000 },
      { id: 3, type: 'expense', amount: 120, category: '交通', date: now - 1 * 86400000 },
      { id: 4, type: 'expense', amount: 299, category: '购物', date: now },
      { id: 5, type: 'income', amount: 200, category: '红包', date: now }
    ];
  }
});
</script>

5. initData() 只能返回稳定默认数据对象；Vue props 的 default（包括数组/对象工厂默认值）必须作为同名字段落入 initData；Vue data() 的全部初始值必须精确等价地保留，包括嵌套对象、数组、数字和启用项集合，不得用空字符串、空数组或删减后的集合替代；如果内部 data 依赖 props，必须在 inited() 中用 this.data.get('propName') 读取并 this.data.set(...) 同步。
6. 组件状态读写必须使用 this.data.get('field') 和 this.data.set('field', value)；San computed 的结果也在 data store 中，computed 之间的依赖以及普通方法读取 computed 时必须使用 this.data.get('computedName')，禁止 this.computed.foo()；Vue 的 this.$emit(...) 或 emitEvent 包装方法必须迁移为 this.fire(...)，禁止 this.props、this.xxx 状态读写、this.$emit 和用 this.dispatch(...) 代替自定义事件。

8. template 必须使用 San 语法：on-click、s-if、s-for；保留事件调用的全部参数，例如 on-click="move(-1)"、on-click="select(task.id)"；Vue v-for 的 :key 必须写入 s-for 的 trackby 子句，例如 s-for="task in tasks trackby task.id"，禁止输出独立 key="{{ task.id }}" 或 key="{= task.id =}"；所有 {{ ... }} 和 {= ... =} 插值必须完整闭合；双向绑定 {= assignable.path =} 只能用于可赋值的数据路径，方法调用、computed 表达式和其他派生值必须使用单向插值；disabled、checked、selected 等派生属性必须使用 disabled="{{ expression }}" 这一类单向插值，禁止写成 disabled="{= expression =}"；方法调用、computed 表达式和其他派生值必须使用单向插值，例如 checked="{{ isEnabled(rule.id, enabled) }}"；禁止丢失参数、使用 data-args/getAttribute 绕行，或保留 @click、v-if、v-for、v-model、:class 等 Vue 模板语法。

        "content": ".expense-tracker {\n  max-width: 550px;\n  margin: 40px auto;\n  padding: 24px;\n  background: #ffffff;\n  border-radius: 20px;\n  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\n  transition: all 0.3s;\n  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;\n}\n\n.expense-tracker.dark-mode {\n  background: #1e293b;\n  color: #e2e8f0;\n}\n\n/* 头部 */\n.header {\n  display: flex;\n  justify-content: space-between;\n  align-items: center;\n  margin-bottom: 24px;\n}\n\n.header h2 {\n  margin: 0;\n}\n\n.theme-btn {\n  padding: 8px 16px;\n  background: #f1f5f9;\n  border: none;\n  border-radius: 10px;\n  cursor: pointer;\n  font-size: 16px;\n}\n\n.dark-mode .theme-btn {\n  background: #334155;\n}\n\n/* 余额卡片 */\n.balance-card {\n  display: flex;\n  gap: 16px;\n  margin-bottom: 24px;\n  padding: 16px;\n  background: #f8fafc;\n  border-radius: 16px;\n}\n\n.dark-mode .balance-card {\n  background: #0f172a;\n}\n\n.balance-item {\n  flex: 1;\n  text-align: center;\n}\n\n.balance-label {\n  display: block;\n  font-size: 12px;\n  color: #64748b;\n  margin-bottom: 8px;\n}\n\n.balance-value {\n  display: block;\n  font-size: 20px;\n  font-weight: 700;\n}\n\n.balance-value.income {\n  color: #10b981;\n}\n\n.balance-value.expense {\n  color: #ef4444;\n}\n\n.balance-value.positive {\n  color: #10b981;\n}\n\n.balance-value.negative {\n  color: #ef4444;\n}\n\n/* 添加表单 */\n.add-form {\n  display: flex;\n  gap: 8px;\n  margin-bottom: 24px;\n  flex-wrap: wrap;\n}\n\n.add-form select,\n.add-form input {\n  padding: 10px 12px;\n  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;\n  border-radius: 10px;\n  font-size: 14px;\n  background: white;\n}\n\n.dark-mode .add-form select,\n.dark-mode .add-form input {\n  background: #0f172a;\n  border-color: #334155;\n  color: #e2e8f0;\n}\n\n.add-form select {\n  width: 80px;\n}\n\n.add-form input:first-of-type {\n  width: 100px;\n}\n\n.add-form input:last-of-type {\n  width: 120px;\n}\n\n.add-form button {\n  padding: 10px 20px;\n  background: #3b82f6;\n  color: white;\n  border: none;\n  border-radius: 10px;\n  cursor: pointer;\n  font-weight: 600;\n}\n\n/* 筛选栏 */\n.filter-bar {\n  display: flex;\n  gap: 12px;\n  margin-bottom: 20px;\n  flex-wrap: wrap;\n}\n\n.filter-bar select {\n  padding: 8px 12px;\n  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;\n  border-radius: 10px;\n  background: white;\n  cursor: pointer;\n}\n\n.dark-mode .filter-bar select {\n  background: #0f172a;\n  border-color: #334155;\n  color: #e2e8f0;\n}\n\n.clear-filter {\n  padding: 8px 16px;\n  background: #f1f5f9;\n  border: none;\n  border-radius: 10px;\n  cursor: pointer;\n  font-size: 12px;\n}\n\n/* 图表区域 */\n.chart-section {\n  margin-bottom: 24px;\n  padding: 16px;\n  background: #f8fafc;\n  border-radius: 16px;\n}\n\n.dark-mode .chart-section {\n  background: #0f172a;\n}\n\n.chart-section h3 {\n  margin: 0 0 16px 0;\n  font-size: 14px;\n}\n\n.chart-bars {\n  display: flex;\n  flex-direction: column;\n  gap: 12px;\n}\n\n.chart-item {\n  display: flex;\n  align-items: center;\n  gap: 12px;\n  font-size: 12px;\n}\n\n.chart-label {\n  width: 50px;\n  font-weight: 500;\n}\n\n.bar-container {\n  flex: 1;\n  display: flex;\n  align-items: center;\n  gap: 8px;\n}\n\n.bar {\n  height: 8px;\n  background: #3b82f6;\n  border-radius: 4px;\n  transition: width 0.3s;\n}\n\n.bar-value {\n  font-size: 12px;\n  color: #64748b;\n  min-width: 45px;\n}\n\n/* 记录列表 */\n.records-list {\n  margin-bottom: 16px;\n  max-height: 350px;\n  overflow-y: auto;\n}\n\n.record-item {\n  display: flex;\n  justify-content: space-between;\n  align-items: center;\n  padding: 12px;\n  margin-bottom: 8px;\n  background: #f8fafc;\n  border-radius: 12px;\n  transition: all 0.2s;\n}\n\n.dark-mode .record-item {\n  background: #0f172a;\n}\n\n.record-item.income {\n  border-left: 4px solid #10b981;\n}\n\n.record-item.expense {\n  border-left: 4px solid #ef4444;\n}\n\n.record-info {\n  flex: 1;\n}\n\n.record-category {\n  display: block;\n  font-weight: 500;\n  font-size: 14px;\n  margin-bottom: 4px;\n}\n\n.record-date {\n  font-size: 11px;\n  color: #94a3b8;\n}\n\n.record-amount {\n  font-weight: 700;\n  font-size: 16px;\n}\n\n.record-amount.income {\n  color: #10b981;\n}\n\n.record-amount.expense {\n  color: #ef4444;\n}\n\n.delete-btn {\n  padding: 4px 12px;\n  background: #fee2e2;\n  color: #ef4444;\n  border: none;\n  border-radius: 8px;\n  cursor: pointer;\n  font-size: 12px;\n  margin-left: 12px;\n}\n\n.dark-mode .delete-btn {\n  background: #450a0a;\n}\n\n.empty-state {\n  text-align: center;\n  padding: 40px;\n  color: #94a3b8;\n}\n\n/* 底部 */\n.footer {\n  display: flex;\n  justify-content: space-between;\n  align-items: center;\n  padding-top: 16px;\n  border-top: 1px solid #e2e8f0;\n  font-size: 13px;\n}\n\n.dark-mode .footer {\n  border-top-color: #334155;\n}\n\n.clear-all {\n  padding: 6px 12px;\n  background: #f1f5f9;\n  border: none;\n  border-radius: 8px;\n  cursor: pointer;\n  font-size: 12px;\n}\n\n.dark-mode .clear-all {\n  background: #334155;\n  color: #e2e8f0;\n}\n\n/* 响应式 */\n@media (max-width: 500px) {\n  .expense-tracker {\n    margin: 20px;\n    padding: 16px;\n  }\n  \n  .balance-card {\n    flex-direction: column;\n    gap: 12px;\n  }\n  \n  .add-form {\n    flex-direction: column;\n  }\n  \n  .add-form select,\n  .add-form input,\n  .add-form button {\n    width: 100%;\n  }\n}",

<template>
<div class="expense-tracker" class="{{isDarkMode ? 'dark-mode' : ''}}">
  <div class="header">
    <h2>💰 记账本</h2>
    <button class="theme-btn" on-click="toggleTheme">{{isDarkMode ? '☀️' : '🌙'}}</button>
  </div>

  <div class="balance-card">
    <div class="balance-item">
      <span class="balance-label">总收入</span>
      <span class="balance-value income">+¥{{totalIncome}}</span>
    </div>
    <div class="balance-item">
      <span class="balance-label">总支出</span>
      <span class="balance-value expense">-¥{{totalExpense}}</span>
    </div>
    <div class="balance-item">
      <span class="balance-label">结余</span>
      <span class="balance-value" class="{{balance >= 0 ? 'positive' : 'negative'}}">¥{{balance}}</span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="add-form">
    <select value="{= newType =}">
      <option value="income">收入</option>
      <option value="expense">支出</option>
    </select>
    <input type="number" placeholder="金额" value="{= newAmount =}" on-keyup.enter="addRecord" />
    <input type="text" placeholder="分类" value="{= newCategory =}" on-keyup.enter="addRecord" />
    <button on-click="addRecord">添加</button>
  </div>

  <div class="filter-bar">
    <select value="{= filterType =}">
      <option value="all">全部</option>
      <option value="income">收入</option>
      <option value="expense">支出</option>
    </select>
    <select value="{= filterCategory =}">
      <option value="all">全部分类</option>
      <option s-for="cat in categories" trackby cat value="{{cat}}">{{cat}}</option>
    </select>
    <button class="clear-filter" s-if="hasFilter" on-click="clearFilter">清除</button>
  </div>

  <div class="chart-section" s-if="expenseByCategory.length > 0">
    <h3>支出分类统计</h3>
    <div class="chart-bars">
      <div class="chart-item" s-for="item in expenseByCategory" trackby item.category>
        <span class="chart-label">{{item.category}}</span>
        <div class="bar-container">
          <div class="bar" style="{{'width: ' + getBarWidth(item.amount) + '%'}}"></div>
          <span class="bar-value">¥{{item.amount}}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="records-list">
    <div class="record-item" s-for="record in filteredRecords" trackby record.id class="{{record.type}}">
      <div class="record-info">
        <span class="record-category">{{record.category}}</span>
        <span class="record-date">{{formatDate(record.date)}}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="record-amount" class="{{record.type}}">{{record.type === 'income' ? '+' : '-'}}¥{{record.amount}}</div>
      <button class="delete-btn" on-click="deleteRecord(record.id)">删除</button>
    </div>
    <div class="empty-state" s-if="filteredRecords.length === 0">暂无记录，添加一笔吧</div>
  </div>

  <div class="footer" s-if="records.length > 0">
    <span>共{{filteredRecords.length}}条记录</span>
    <button class="clear-all" on-click="clearAll">清空全部</button>
  </div>
</template>

<script>
const san = require('san');
const DataTypes = san.DataTypes;

module.exports = san.defineComponent({
  name: 'ExpenseTracker',

  dataTypes: {
    isDarkMode: DataTypes.bool,
    records: DataTypes.array,
    newType: DataTypes.string,
    newAmount: DataTypes.string,
    newCategory: DataTypes.string,
    filterType: DataTypes.string,
    filterCategory: DataTypes.string
  },

  initData() {
    return {
      isDarkMode: false,
      records: [],
      newType: 'expense',
      newAmount: '',
      newCategory: '',
      filterType: 'all',
      filterCategory: 'all'
    };
  },

  inited() {
    this.loadFromLocal();
  },

  computed: {
    totalIncome() {
      return this.data.get('records')
        .filter(r => r.type === 'income')
        .reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.amount, 0);
    },

    totalExpense() {
      return this.data.get('records')
        .filter(r => r.type === 'expense')
        .reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.amount, 0);
    },

    balance() {
      return this.data.get('totalIncome') - this.data.get('totalExpense');
    },

    categories() {
      const records = this.data.get('records');
      const cats = [...new Set(records.map(r => r.category))];
      return cats.sort();
    },

    expenseByCategory() {
      const records = this.data.get('records');
      const categoryMap = new Map();
      records
        .filter(r => r.type === 'expense')
        .forEach(r => {
          const current = categoryMap.get(r.category) || 0;
          categoryMap.set(r.category, current + r.amount);
        });
      return Array.from(categoryMap.entries())
        .map(([category, amount]) => ({ category, amount }))
        .sort((a, b) => b.amount - a.amount);
    },

    maxExpenseAmount() {
      const expenseByCategory = this.data.get('expenseByCategory');
      if (expenseByCategory.length === 0) return 0;
      return Math.max(...expenseByCategory.map(item => item.amount));
    },

    filteredRecords() {
      let result = [...this.data.get('records')];

      if (this.data.get('filterType') !== 'all') {
        result = result.filter(r => r.type === this.data.get('filterType'));
      }

      if (this.data.get('filterCategory') !== 'all') {
        result = result.filter(r => r.category === this.data.get('filterCategory'));
      }

      return result.sort((a, b) => b.date - a.date);
    },

    hasFilter() {
      return this.data.get('filterType') !== 'all' || this.data.get('filterCategory') !== 'all';
    }
  },

  addRecord() {
    const amount = parseFloat(this.data.get('newAmount'));
    if (isNaN(amount) || amount <= 0) {
      alert('请输入有效的金额');
      return;
    }
    if (!this.data.get('newCategory').trim()) {
      alert('请输入分类');
      return;
    }

    const newRecord = {
      id: Date.now(),
      type: this.data.get('newType'),
      amount: amount,
      category: this.data.get('newCategory').trim(),
      date: Date.now()
    };

    const records = this.data.get('records');
    records.push(newRecord);
    this.data.set('records', records);

    this.data.set('newAmount', '');
    this.data.set('newCategory', '');
    this.saveToLocal();
  },

  deleteRecord(id) {
    const records = this.data.get('records').filter(r => r.id !== id);
    this.data.set('records', records);
    this.saveToLocal();
  },

  clearAll() {
    if (confirm('确定要清空所有记录吗？')) {
      this.data.set('records', []);
      this.saveToLocal();
    }
  },

  clearFilter() {
    this.data.set('filterType', 'all');
    this.data.set('filterCategory', 'all');
  },

  getBarWidth(amount) {
    const maxExpenseAmount = this.data.get('maxExpenseAmount');
    if (maxExpenseAmount === 0) return 0;
    return (amount / maxExpenseAmount) * 100;
  },

  formatDate(timestamp) {
    const date = new Date(timestamp);
    const now = new Date();
    const today = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());
    const yesterday = new Date(today - 86400000);

    if (timestamp >= today) {
      return `今天 ${date.getHours()}:${String(date.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
    } else if (timestamp >= yesterday) {
      return '昨天';
    } else {
      return `${date.getMonth() + 1}/${date.getDate()}`;
    }
  },

  toggleTheme() {
    this.data.set('isDarkMode', !this.data.get('isDarkMode'));
  },

  saveToLocal() {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('expense_records', JSON.stringify(this.data.get('records')));
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Failed to save to localStorage:', e);
    }
  },

  loadFromLocal() {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem('expense_records');
      if (saved) {
        try {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(saved);
          this.data.set('records', this.normalizeRecords(parsed));
        } catch (e) {
          this.data.set('records', this.getSampleRecords());
        }
      } else {
        this.data.set('records', this.getSampleRecords());
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Failed to load from localStorage:', e);
      this.data.set('records', this.getSampleRecords());
    }
  },

  normalizeRecords(records) {
    if (!Array.isArray(records)) {
      return this.getSampleRecords();
    }

    return records
      .map((record, index) => {
        if (!record || typeof record !== 'object') {
          return null;
        }

        const type = record.type === 'income' ? 'income' : (record.type === 'expense' ? 'expense' : null);
        const amount = Number(record.amount);
        const category = typeof record.category === 'string' ? record.category.trim() : '';
        const date = Number(record.date);
        const id = record.id != null ? record.id : Date.now() + index;

        if (!type || !Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0 || !category || !Number.isFinite(date)) {
          return null;
        }

        return { id, type, amount, category, date };
      })
      .filter(Boolean);
  },

  getSampleRecords() {
    const now = Date.now();
    return [
      { id: 1, type: 'income', amount: 5000, category: '工资', date: now - 2 * 86400000 },
      { id: 2, type: 'expense', amount: 68, category: '餐饮', date: now - 1 * 86400000 },
      { id: 3, type: 'expense', amount: 120, category: '交通', date: now - 1 * 86400000 },
      { id: 4, type: 'expense', amount: 299, category: '购物', date: now },
      { id: 5, type: 'income', amount: 200, category: '红包', date: now }
    ];
  }
});
</script>

san_generation_contract.description: 约束大模型基于本 schema 生成 San 组件时必须满足的条件。
must_preserve: metadata.component_name 和根节点语义
template.dom_tree 的层级结构、节点顺序与语义角色
template.component_refs 中每个子组件的注册名和父子通信事件
binding_graph 中 data/props/computed 到模板节点的可见绑定
event_model 中每个 DOM 事件和自定义事件的触发时机与 payload
style_model 中动态类名、动态样式、scoped CSS 和关键视觉状态
script.options.lifecycle_hooks 中的副作用初始化与清理逻辑
script.options.data 中所有字段的默认值和外部初始化来源
quality_checks: template.component_refs 中每个子组件都在 script.components 或 san_registration 中有定义
binding_graph.edges 中每条 template 依赖都能在 script.options 中找到来源
event_model.dom_events 中每个 handler_name 都存在于 script.options.methods
event_model.custom_events 中每个 emit_points 都对应 method 中的 $emit 调用
style_model.dynamic_class_bindings 的 dependencies 都存在于 binding_graph.nodes
script.options.watch 中的 deep watcher 在 migration_hints 中被标记并给出替代策略
san_syntax_requirements: 输出完整的 .san 单文件组件，包含 <template>、<script>、<style> 三个代码块；若无样式也保留空 style 或显式说明无样式
脚本块显式引入 san：const san = require('san')，并使用 module.exports = san.defineComponent(...) 导出组件
props 使用 san.DataTypes 声明，与 script.options.props 一一对应；优先输出 DataTypes.number / string / bool / array / object
组件定义使用 san.defineComponent
组件名来自 metadata.component_name，并显式输出 name 字段
data 使用 initData 返回默认值，与 script.options.data 一一对应；不要在 initData 中直接依赖复杂运行时读取
当 data 字段来源于 props 或外部初始化时，优先在 inited/attached 中用 this.data.set 完成同步
模板中使用 s-if、s-for、on-event、value={= =}、checked={= =} 等 San 语法
状态访问统一使用 this.data.get() / this.data.set()
优先将 methods 直接定义在组件对象顶层，避免保留 Vue 风格的 methods: {} 包裹
子组件标签使用短横线命名
子组件在 components 中显式注册
样式块需尽量完整输出，优先复用 styles/style_model 中已有 class 与 css_rules 信息
定时器、timeout、外部监听等副作用在 attached/disposed 中管理

你是一个 Vue 到 San 迁移修复专家。请根据 SSM、当前 San 代码和校验报告，修复 San 单文件组件。
修复目标：输出必须满足下面列出的 San 结构、语法和渲染一致性规则；不要只生成语义上看起来像 San 的代码。

输出要求：
1. 只输出完整 .san 文件内容，不要输出解释、标题或 Markdown 代码围栏。
2. 必须包含 <template>、<script>、<style> 三段。
3. <script> 中必须使用 const san = require('san')、const DataTypes = san.DataTypes、module.exports = san.defineComponent(...)。
4. Vue props 必须迁移为 San dataTypes，禁止在 san.defineComponent 中输出 props: {...}。
5. initData() 只能返回稳定默认数据对象；Vue props 的 default（包括数组/对象工厂默认值）必须作为同名字段落入 initData；Vue data() 的全部初始值必须精确等价地保留，包括嵌套对象、数组、数字和启用项集合，不得用空字符串、空数组或删减后的集合替代；如果内部 data 依赖 props，必须在 inited() 中用 this.data.get('propName') 读取并 this.data.set(...) 同步。
6. 组件状态读写必须使用 this.data.get('field') 和 this.data.set('field', value)；San computed 的结果也在 data store 中，computed 之间的依赖以及普通方法读取 computed 时必须使用 this.data.get('computedName')，禁止 this.computed.foo()；Vue 的 this.$emit(...) 或 emitEvent 包装方法必须迁移为 this.fire(...)，禁止 this.props、this.xxx 状态读写、this.$emit 和用 this.dispatch(...) 代替自定义事件。
7. 方法必须直接定义在 san.defineComponent 顶层，禁止保留 Vue 的 methods: {...} 包裹。
8. template 必须使用 San 语法：on-click、s-if、s-for；保留事件调用的全部参数，例如 on-click="move(-1)"、on-click="select(task.id)"；Vue v-for 的 :key 必须写入 s-for 的 trackby 子句，例如 s-for="task in tasks trackby task.id"，禁止输出独立 key="{{ task.id }}" 或 key="{= task.id =}"；所有 {{ ... }} 和 {= ... =} 插值必须完整闭合；双向绑定 {= assignable.path =} 只能用于可赋值的数据路径，方法调用、computed 表达式和其他派生值必须使用单向插值；disabled、checked、selected 等派生属性必须使用 disabled="{{ expression }}" 这一类单向插值，禁止写成 disabled="{= expression =}"；方法调用、computed 表达式和其他派生值必须使用单向插值，例如 checked="{{ isEnabled(rule.id, enabled) }}"；禁止丢失参数、使用 data-args/getAttribute 绕行，或保留 @click、v-if、v-for、v-model、:class 等 Vue 模板语法。
9. style 标签必须写成 <style>，禁止输出 <style scoped>；必须保留原有 class 名和样式内容。
10. 不要重新设计组件，不要引入外部依赖，不要删除已有 DOM 节点、文本、class 或样式。
11. 如果 DOM 对比报告指出缺失/新增/变化节点，优先修复 template 结构。
12. 补充要求：优先修复 validate 与 visual_eval 报告中指出的问题，保持原有 DOM 结构、文本、class 和样式。

修复前请按下面清单自检，但最终不要输出清单：
- 是否存在 props:、methods:、this.props、this.$emit、this.dispatch、<style scoped>、@click、v-if、v-for、v-model、:class？如果存在，必须改掉。
- SSM props 是否全部出现在 dataTypes 中？
- 带 default 的 Vue props 是否以同名字段和等价默认值出现在 initData 中？
- Vue data() 中每个初始值是否精确保留了原始类型、嵌套内容、数组元素和数值，而不是空值或删减值？
- computed 之间以及普通方法中是否只通过 this.data.get('computedName') 读取 computed，且完全不存在 this.computed.foo()？
- 所有 {= ... =} 是否都是可赋值数据路径；disabled、checked、selected 等派生属性是否使用 {{ ... }} 单向插值；方法调用和 computed 等派生表达式是否使用 {{ ... }} 单向插值？
- 所有 {{ ... }} 和 {= ... =} 是否完整闭合；Vue v-for 的 :key 是否迁移为 s-for 内联 trackby，且不存在独立 key 属性？
- 事件绑定中的参数是否完整保留，且没有 data-args/getAttribute 绕行？

        "content": ".expense-tracker {\n  max-width: 550px;\n  margin: 40px auto;\n  padding: 24px;\n  background: #ffffff;\n  border-radius: 20px;\n  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\n  transition: all 0.3s;\n  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;\n}\n\n.expense-tracker.dark-mode {\n  background: #1e293b;\n  color: #e2e8f0;\n}\n\n/* 头部 */\n.header {\n  display: flex;\n  justify-content: space-between;\n  align-items: center;\n  margin-bottom: 24px;\n}\n\n.header h2 {\n  margin: 0;\n}\n\n.theme-btn {\n  padding: 8px 16px;\n  background: #f1f5f9;\n  border: none;\n  border-radius: 10px;\n  cursor: pointer;\n  font-size: 16px;\n}\n\n.dark-mode .theme-btn {\n  background: #334155;\n}\n\n/* 余额卡片 */\n.balance-card {\n  display: flex;\n  gap: 16px;\n  margin-bottom: 24px;\n  padding: 16px;\n  background: #f8fafc;\n  border-radius: 16px;\n}\n\n.dark-mode .balance-card {\n  background: #0f172a;\n}\n\n.balance-item {\n  flex: 1;\n  text-align: center;\n}\n\n.balance-label {\n  display: block;\n  font-size: 12px;\n  color: #64748b;\n  margin-bottom: 8px;\n}\n\n.balance-value {\n  display: block;\n  font-size: 20px;\n  font-weight: 700;\n}\n\n.balance-value.income {\n  color: #10b981;\n}\n\n.balance-value.expense {\n  color: #ef4444;\n}\n\n.balance-value.positive {\n  color: #10b981;\n}\n\n.balance-value.negative {\n  color: #ef4444;\n}\n\n/* 添加表单 */\n.add-form {\n  display: flex;\n  gap: 8px;\n  margin-bottom: 24px;\n  flex-wrap: wrap;\n}\n\n.add-form select,\n.add-form input {\n  padding: 10px 12px;\n  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;\n  border-radius: 10px;\n  font-size: 14px;\n  background: white;\n}\n\n.dark-mode .add-form select,\n.dark-mode .add-form input {\n  background: #0f172a;\n  border-color: #334155;\n  color: #e2e8f0;\n}\n\n.add-form select {\n  width: 80px;\n}\n\n.add-form input:first-of-type {\n  width: 100px;\n}\n\n.add-form input:last-of-type {\n  width: 120px;\n}\n\n.add-form button {\n  padding: 10px 20px;\n  background: #3b82f6;\n  color: white;\n  border: none;\n  border-radius: 10px;\n  cursor: pointer;\n  font-weight: 600;\n}\n\n/* 筛选栏 */\n.filter-bar {\n  display: flex;\n  gap: 12px;\n  margin-bottom: 20px;\n  flex-wrap: wrap;\n}\n\n.filter-bar select {\n  padding: 8px 12px;\n  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;\n  border-radius: 10px;\n  background: white;\n  cursor: pointer;\n}\n\n.dark-mode .filter-bar select {\n  background: #0f172a;\n  border-color: #334155;\n  color: #e2e8f0;\n}\n\n.clear-filter {\n  padding: 8px 16px;\n  background: #f1f5f9;\n  border: none;\n  border-radius: 10px;\n  cursor: pointer;\n  font-size: 12px;\n}\n\n/* 图表区域 */\n.chart-section {\n  margin-bottom: 24px;\n  padding: 16px;\n  background: #f8fafc;\n  border-radius: 16px;\n}\n\n.dark-mode .chart-section {\n  background: #0f172a;\n}\n\n.chart-section h3 {\n  margin: 0 0 16px 0;\n  font-size: 14px;\n}\n\n.chart-bars {\n  display: flex;\n  flex-direction: column;\n  gap: 12px;\n}\n\n.chart-item {\n  display: flex;\n  align-items: center;\n  gap: 12px;\n  font-size: 12px;\n}\n\n.chart-label {\n  width: 50px;\n  font-weight: 500;\n}\n\n.bar-container {\n  flex: 1;\n  display: flex;\n  align-items: center;\n  gap: 8px;\n}\n\n.bar {\n  height: 8px;\n  background: #3b82f6;\n  border-radius: 4px;\n  transition: width 0.3s;\n}\n\n.bar-value {\n  font-size: 12px;\n  color: #64748b;\n  min-width: 45px;\n}\n\n/* 记录列表 */\n.records-list {\n  margin-bottom: 16px;\n  max-height: 350px;\n  overflow-y: auto;\n}\n\n.record-item {\n  display: flex;\n  justify-content: space-between;\n  align-items: center;\n  padding: 12px;\n  margin-bottom: 8px;\n  background: #f8fafc;\n  border-radius: 12px;\n  transition: all 0.2s;\n}\n\n.dark-mode .record-item {\n  background: #0f172a;\n}\n\n.record-item.income {\n  border-left: 4px solid #10b981;\n}\n\n.record-item.expense {\n  border-left: 4px solid #ef4444;\n}\n\n.record-info {\n  flex: 1;\n}\n\n.record-category {\n  display: block;\n  font-weight: 500;\n  font-size: 14px;\n  margin-bottom: 4px;\n}\n\n.record-date {\n  font-size: 11px;\n  color: #94a3b8;\n}\n\n.record-amount {\n  font-weight: 700;\n  font-size: 16px;\n}\n\n.record-amount.income {\n  color: #10b981;\n}\n\n.record-amount.expense {\n  color: #ef4444;\n}\n\n.delete-btn {\n  padding: 4px 12px;\n  background: #fee2e2;\n  color: #ef4444;\n  border: none;\n  border-radius: 8px;\n  cursor: pointer;\n  font-size: 12px;\n  margin-left: 12px;\n}\n\n.dark-mode .delete-btn {\n  background: #450a0a;\n}\n\n.empty-state {\n  text-align: center;\n  padding: 40px;\n  color: #94a3b8;\n}\n\n/* 底部 */\n.footer {\n  display: flex;\n  justify-content: space-between;\n  align-items: center;\n  padding-top: 16px;\n  border-top: 1px solid #e2e8f0;\n  font-size: 13px;\n}\n\n.dark-mode .footer {\n  border-top-color: #334155;\n}\n\n.clear-all {\n  padding: 6px 12px;\n  background: #f1f5f9;\n  border: none;\n  border-radius: 8px;\n  cursor: pointer;\n  font-size: 12px;\n}\n\n.dark-mode .clear-all {\n  background: #334155;\n  color: #e2e8f0;\n}\n\n/* 响应式 */\n@media (max-width: 500px) {\n  .expense-tracker {\n    margin: 20px;\n    padding: 16px;\n  }\n  \n  .balance-card {\n    flex-direction: column;\n    gap: 12px;\n  }\n  \n  .add-form {\n    flex-direction: column;\n  }\n  \n  .add-form select,\n  .add-form input,\n  .add-form button {\n    width: 100%;\n  }\n}",

<template>
<div class="expense-tracker" class="{{isDarkMode ? 'dark-mode' : ''}}">
  <div class="header">
    <h2>💰 记账本</h2>
    <button class="theme-btn" on-click="toggleTheme">{{isDarkMode ? '☀️' : '🌙'}}</button>
  </div>

  <div class="balance-card">
    <div class="balance-item">
      <span class="balance-label">总收入</span>
      <span class="balance-value income">+¥{{totalIncome}}</span>
    </div>
    <div class="balance-item">
      <span class="balance-label">总支出</span>
      <span class="balance-value expense">-¥{{totalExpense}}</span>
    </div>
    <div class="balance-item">
      <span class="balance-label">结余</span>
      <span class="balance-value" class="{{balance >= 0 ? 'positive' : 'negative'}}">¥{{balance}}</span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="add-form">
    <select value="{= newType =}">
      <option value="income">收入</option>
      <option value="expense">支出</option>
    </select>
    <input type="number" placeholder="金额" value="{= newAmount =}" on-keyup.enter="addRecord" />
    <input type="text" placeholder="分类" value="{= newCategory =}" on-keyup.enter="addRecord" />
    <button on-click="addRecord">添加</button>
  </div>

  <div class="filter-bar">
    <select value="{= filterType =}">
      <option value="all">全部</option>
      <option value="income">收入</option>
      <option value="expense">支出</option>
    </select>
    <select value="{= filterCategory =}">
      <option value="all">全部分类</option>
      <option s-for="cat in categories" trackby cat value="{{cat}}">{{cat}}</option>
    </select>
    <button class="clear-filter" s-if="hasFilter" on-click="clearFilter">清除</button>
  </div>

  <div class="chart-section" s-if="expenseByCategory.length > 0">
    <h3>支出分类统计</h3>
    <div class="chart-bars">
      <div class="chart-item" s-for="item in expenseByCategory" trackby item.category>
        <span class="chart-label">{{item.category}}</span>
        <div class="bar-container">
          <div class="bar" style="{{'width: ' + getBarWidth(item.amount) + '%'}}"></div>
          <span class="bar-value">¥{{item.amount}}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="records-list">
    <div class="record-item" s-for="record in filteredRecords" trackby record.id class="{{record.type}}">
      <div class="record-info">
        <span class="record-category">{{record.category}}</span>
        <span class="record-date">{{formatDate(record.date)}}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="record-amount" class="{{record.type}}">{{record.type === 'income' ? '+' : '-'}}¥{{record.amount}}</div>
      <button class="delete-btn" on-click="deleteRecord(record.id)">删除</button>
    </div>
    <div class="empty-state" s-if="filteredRecords.length === 0">暂无记录，添加一笔吧</div>
  </div>

  <div class="footer" s-if="records.length > 0">
    <span>共{{filteredRecords.length}}条记录</span>
    <button class="clear-all" on-click="clearAll">清空全部</button>
  </div>
</template>

<script>
const san = require('san');
const DataTypes = san.DataTypes;

module.exports = san.defineComponent({
  name: 'ExpenseTracker',

  dataTypes: {
    isDarkMode: DataTypes.bool,
    records: DataTypes.array,
    newType: DataTypes.string,
    newAmount: DataTypes.string,
    newCategory: DataTypes.string,
    filterType: DataTypes.string,
    filterCategory: DataTypes.string
  },

  initData() {
    return {
      isDarkMode: false,
      records: [],
      newType: 'expense',
      newAmount: '',
      newCategory: '',
      filterType: 'all',
      filterCategory: 'all'
    };
  },

  inited() {
    this.loadFromLocal();
  },

  computed: {
    totalIncome() {
      return this.data.get('records')
        .filter(r => r.type === 'income')
        .reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.amount, 0);
    },

    totalExpense() {
      return this.data.get('records')
        .filter(r => r.type === 'expense')
        .reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.amount, 0);
    },

    balance() {
      return this.data.get('totalIncome') - this.data.get('totalExpense');
    },

    categories() {
      const records = this.data.get('records');
      const cats = [...new Set(records.map(r => r.category))];
      return cats.sort();
    },

    expenseByCategory() {
      const records = this.data.get('records');
      const categoryMap = new Map();
      records
        .filter(r => r.type === 'expense')
        .forEach(r => {
          const current = categoryMap.get(r.category) || 0;
          categoryMap.set(r.category, current + r.amount);
        });
      return Array.from(categoryMap.entries())
        .map(([category, amount]) => ({ category, amount }))
        .sort((a, b) => b.amount - a.amount);
    },

    maxExpenseAmount() {
      const expenseByCategory = this.data.get('expenseByCategory');
      if (expenseByCategory.length === 0) return 0;
      return Math.max(...expenseByCategory.map(item => item.amount));
    },

    filteredRecords() {
      let result = [...this.data.get('records')];

      if (this.data.get('filterType') !== 'all') {
        result = result.filter(r => r.type === this.data.get('filterType'));
      }

      if (this.data.get('filterCategory') !== 'all') {
        result = result.filter(r => r.category === this.data.get('filterCategory'));
      }

      return result.sort((a, b) => b.date - a.date);
    },

    hasFilter() {
      return this.data.get('filterType') !== 'all' || this.data.get('filterCategory') !== 'all';
    }
  },

  addRecord() {
    const amount = parseFloat(this.data.get('newAmount'));
    if (isNaN(amount) || amount <= 0) {
      alert('请输入有效的金额');
      return;
    }
    if (!this.data.get('newCategory').trim()) {
      alert('请输入分类');
      return;
    }

    const newRecord = {
      id: Date.now(),
      type: this.data.get('newType'),
      amount: amount,
      category: this.data.get('newCategory').trim(),
      date: Date.now()
    };

    const records = this.data.get('records');
    records.push(newRecord);
    this.data.set('records', records);

    this.data.set('newAmount', '');
    this.data.set('newCategory', '');
    this.saveToLocal();
  },

  deleteRecord(id) {
    const records = this.data.get('records').filter(r => r.id !== id);
    this.data.set('records', records);
    this.saveToLocal();
  },

  clearAll() {
    if (confirm('确定要清空所有记录吗？')) {
      this.data.set('records', []);
      this.saveToLocal();
    }
  },

  clearFilter() {
    this.data.set('filterType', 'all');
    this.data.set('filterCategory', 'all');
  },

  getBarWidth(amount) {
    const maxExpenseAmount = this.data.get('maxExpenseAmount');
    if (maxExpenseAmount === 0) return 0;
    return (amount / maxExpenseAmount) * 100;
  },

  formatDate(timestamp) {
    const date = new Date(timestamp);
    const now = new Date();
    const today = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());
    const yesterday = new Date(today - 86400000);

    if (timestamp >= today) {
      return `今天 ${date.getHours()}:${String(date.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
    } else if (timestamp >= yesterday) {
      return '昨天';
    } else {
      return `${date.getMonth() + 1}/${date.getDate()}`;
    }
  },

  toggleTheme() {
    this.data.set('isDarkMode', !this.data.get('isDarkMode'));
  },

  saveToLocal() {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('expense_records', JSON.stringify(this.data.get('records')));
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Failed to save to localStorage:', e);
    }
  },

  loadFromLocal() {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem('expense_records');
      if (saved) {
        try {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(saved);
          this.data.set('records', this.normalizeRecords(parsed));
        } catch (e) {
          this.data.set('records', this.getSampleRecords());
        }
      } else {
        this.data.set('records', this.getSampleRecords());
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Failed to load from localStorage:', e);
      this.data.set('records', this.getSampleRecords());
    }
  },

  normalizeRecords(records) {
    if (!Array.isArray(records)) {
      return this.getSampleRecords();
    }

    return records
      .map((record, index) => {
        if (!record || typeof record !== 'object') {
          return null;
        }

        const type = record.type === 'income' ? 'income' : (record.type === 'expense' ? 'expense' : null);
        const amount = Number(record.amount);
        const category = typeof record.category === 'string' ? record.category.trim() : '';
        const date = Number(record.date);
        const id = record.id != null ? record.id : Date.now() + index;

        if (!type || !Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0 || !category || !Number.isFinite(date)) {
          return null;
        }

        return { id, type, amount, category, date };
      })
      .filter(Boolean);
  },

  getSampleRecords() {
    const now = Date.now();
    return [
      { id: 1, type: 'income', amount: 5000, category: '工资', date: now - 2 * 86400000 },
      { id: 2, type: 'expense', amount: 68, category: '餐饮', date: now - 1 * 86400000 },
      { id: 3, type: 'expense', amount: 120, category: '交通', date: now - 1 * 86400000 },
      { id: 4, type: 'expense', amount: 299, category: '购物', date: now },
      { id: 5, type: 'income', amount: 200, category: '红包', date: now }
    ];
  }
});
</script>

repair_result.repair_prompt:
你是一个 Vue 到 San 迁移修复专家。请根据 SSM、当前 San 代码和校验报告，修复 San 单文件组件。
修复目标：输出必须满足下面列出的 San 结构、语法和渲染一致性规则；不要只生成语义上看起来像 San 的代码。

输出要求：
1. 只输出完整 .san 文件内容，不要输出解释、标题或 Markdown 代码围栏。
2. 必须包含 <template>、<script>、<style> 三段。
3. <script> 中必须使用 const san = require('san')、const DataTypes = san.DataTypes、module.exports = san.defineComponent(...)。
4. Vue props 必须迁移为 San dataTypes，禁止在 san.defineComponent 中输出 props: {...}。
5. initData() 只能返回稳定默认数据对象；Vue props 的 default（包括数组/对象工厂默认值）必须作为同名字段落入 initData；Vue data() 的全部初始值必须精确等价地保留，包括嵌套对象、数组、数字和启用项集合，不得用空字符串、空数组或删减后的集合替代；如果内部 data 依赖 props，必须在 inited() 中用 this.data.get('propName') 读取并 this.data.set(...) 同步。
6. 组件状态读写必须使用 this.data.get('field') 和 this.data.set('field', value)；San computed 的结果也在 data store 中，computed 之间的依赖以及普通方法读取 computed 时必须使用 this.data.get('computedName')，禁止 this.computed.foo()；Vue 的 this.$emit(...) 或 emitEvent 包装方法必须迁移为 this.fire(...)，禁止 this.props、this.xxx 状态读写、this.$emit 和用 this.dispatch(...) 代替自定义事件。
7. 方法必须直接定义在 san.defineComponent 顶层，禁止保留 Vue 的 methods: {...} 包裹。
8. template 必须使用 San 语法：on-click、s-if、s-for；保留事件调用的全部参数，例如 on-click="move(-1)"、on-click="select(task.id)"；Vue v-for 的 :key 必须写入 s-for 的 trackby 子句，例如 s-for="task in tasks trackby task.id"，禁止输出独立 key="{{ task.id }}" 或 key="{= task.id =}"；所有 {{ ... }} 和 {= ... =} 插值必须完整闭合；双向绑定 {= assignable.path =} 只能用于可赋值的数据路径，方法调用、computed 表达式和其他派生值必须使用单向插值；disabled、checked、selected 等派生属性必须使用 disabled="{{ expression }}" 这一类单向插值，禁止写成 disabled="{= expression =}"；方法调用、computed 表达式和其他派生值必须使用单向插值，例如 checked="{{ isEnabled(rule.id, enabled) }}"；禁止丢失参数、使用 data-args/getAttribute 绕行，或保留 @click、v-if、v-for、v-model、:class 等 Vue 模板语法。
9. style 标签必须写成 <style>，禁止输出 <style scoped>；必须保留原有 class 名和样式内容。
10. 不要重新设计组件，不要引入外部依赖，不要删除已有 DOM 节点、文本、class 或样式。
11. 如果 DOM 对比报告指出缺失/新增/变化节点，优先修复 template 结构。
12. 补充要求：优先修复 validate 与 visual_eval 报告中指出的问题，保持原有 DOM 结构、文本、class 和样式。

修复前请按下面清单自检，但最终不要输出清单：
- 是否存在 props:、methods:、this.props、this.$emit、this.dispatch、<style scoped>、@click、v-if、v-for、v-model、:class？如果存在，必须改掉。
- SSM props 是否全部出现在 dataTypes 中？
- 带 default 的 Vue props 是否以同名字段和等价默认值出现在 initData 中？
- Vue data() 中每个初始值是否精确保留了原始类型、嵌套内容、数组元素和数值，而不是空值或删减值？
- computed 之间以及普通方法中是否只通过 this.data.get('computedName') 读取 computed，且完全不存在 this.computed.foo()？
- 所有 {= ... =} 是否都是可赋值数据路径；disabled、checked、selected 等派生属性是否使用 {{ ... }} 单向插值；方法调用和 computed 等派生表达式是否使用 {{ ... }} 单向插值？
- 所有 {{ ... }} 和 {= ... =} 是否完整闭合；Vue v-for 的 :key 是否迁移为 s-for 内联 trackby，且不存在独立 key 属性？
- 事件绑定中的参数是否完整保留，且没有 data-args/getAttribute 绕行？
- SSM data 字段是否全部在 initData 或 this.data.set 中有对应？

        "content": ".expense-tracker {\n  max-width: 550px;\n  margin: 40px auto;\n  padding: 24px;\n  background: #ffffff;\n  border-radius: 20px;\n  box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);\n  transition: all 0.3s;\n  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;\n}\n\n.expense-tracker.dark-mode {\n  background: #1e293b;\n  color: #e2e8f0;\n}\n\n/* 头部 */\n.header {\n  display: flex;\n  justify-content: space-between;\n  align-items: center;\n  margin-bottom: 24px;\n}\n\n.header h2 {\n  margin: 0;\n}\n\n.theme-btn {\n  padding: 8px 16px;\n  background: #f1f5f9;\n  border: none;\n  border-radius: 10px;\n  cursor: pointer;\n  font-size: 16px;\n}\n\n.dark-mode .theme-btn {\n  background: #334155;\n}\n\n/* 余额卡片 */\n.balance-card {\n  display: flex;\n  gap: 16px;\n  margin-bottom: 24px;\n  padding: 16px;\n  background: #f8fafc;\n  border-radius: 16px;\n}\n\n.dark-mode .balance-card {\n  background: #0f172a;\n}\n\n.balance-item {\n  flex: 1;\n  text-align: center;\n}\n\n.balance-label {\n  display: block;\n  font-size: 12px;\n  color: #64748b;\n  margin-bottom: 8px;\n}\n\n.balance-value {\n  display: block;\n  font-size: 20px;\n  font-weight: 700;\n}\n\n.balance-value.income {\n  color: #10b981;\n}\n\n.balance-value.expense {\n  color: #ef4444;\n}\n\n.balance-value.positive {\n  color: #10b981;\n}\n\n.balance-value.negative {\n  color: #ef4444;\n}\n\n/* 添加表单 */\n.add-form {\n  display: flex;\n  gap: 8px;\n  margin-bottom: 24px;\n  flex-wrap: wrap;\n}\n\n.add-form select,\n.add-form input {\n  padding: 10px 12px;\n  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;\n  border-radius: 10px;\n  font-size: 14px;\n  background: white;\n}\n\n.dark-mode .add-form select,\n.dark-mode .add-form input {\n  background: #0f172a;\n  border-color: #334155;\n  color: #e2e8f0;\n}\n\n.add-form select {\n  width: 80px;\n}\n\n.add-form input:first-of-type {\n  width: 100px;\n}\n\n.add-form input:last-of-type {\n  width: 120px;\n}\n\n.add-form button {\n  padding: 10px 20px;\n  background: #3b82f6;\n  color: white;\n  border: none;\n  border-radius: 10px;\n  cursor: pointer;\n  font-weight: 600;\n}\n\n/* 筛选栏 */\n.filter-bar {\n  display: flex;\n  gap: 12px;\n  margin-bottom: 20px;\n  flex-wrap: wrap;\n}\n\n.filter-bar select {\n  padding: 8px 12px;\n  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;\n  border-radius: 10px;\n  background: white;\n  cursor: pointer;\n}\n\n.dark-mode .filter-bar select {\n  background: #0f172a;\n  border-color: #334155;\n  color: #e2e8f0;\n}\n\n.clear-filter {\n  padding: 8px 16px;\n  background: #f1f5f9;\n  border: none;\n  border-radius: 10px;\n  cursor: pointer;\n  font-size: 12px;\n}\n\n/* 图表区域 */\n.chart-section {\n  margin-bottom: 24px;\n  padding: 16px;\n  background: #f8fafc;\n  border-radius: 16px;\n}\n\n.dark-mode .chart-section {\n  background: #0f172a;\n}\n\n.chart-section h3 {\n  margin: 0 0 16px 0;\n  font-size: 14px;\n}\n\n.chart-bars {\n  display: flex;\n  flex-direction: column;\n  gap: 12px;\n}\n\n.chart-item {\n  display: flex;\n  align-items: center;\n  gap: 12px;\n  font-size: 12px;\n}\n\n.chart-label {\n  width: 50px;\n  font-weight: 500;\n}\n\n.bar-container {\n  flex: 1;\n  display: flex;\n  align-items: center;\n  gap: 8px;\n}\n\n.bar {\n  height: 8px;\n  background: #3b82f6;\n  border-radius: 4px;\n  transition: width 0.3s;\n}\n\n.bar-value {\n  font-size: 12px;\n  color: #64748b;\n  min-width: 45px;\n}\n\n/* 记录列表 */\n.records-list {\n  margin-bottom: 16px;\n  max-height: 350px;\n  overflow-y: auto;\n}\n\n.record-item {\n  display: flex;\n  justify-content: space-between;\n  align-items: center;\n  padding: 12px;\n  margin-bottom: 8px;\n  background: #f8fafc;\n  border-radius: 12px;\n  transition: all 0.2s;\n}\n\n.dark-mode .record-item {\n  background: #0f172a;\n}\n\n.record-item.income {\n  border-left: 4px solid #10b981;\n}\n\n.record-item.expense {\n  border-left: 4px solid #ef4444;\n}\n\n.record-info {\n  flex: 1;\n}\n\n.record-category {\n  display: block;\n  font-weight: 500;\n  font-size: 14px;\n  margin-bottom: 4px;\n}\n\n.record-date {\n  font-size: 11px;\n  color: #94a3b8;\n}\n\n.record-amount {\n  font-weight: 700;\n  font-size: 16px;\n}\n\n.record-amount.income {\n  color: #10b981;\n}\n\n.record-amount.expense {\n  color: #ef4444;\n}\n\n.delete-btn {\n  padding: 4px 12px;\n  background: #fee2e2;\n  color: #ef4444;\n  border: none;\n  border-radius: 8px;\n  cursor: pointer;\n  font-size: 12px;\n  margin-left: 12px;\n}\n\n.dark-mode .delete-btn {\n  background: #450a0a;\n}\n\n.empty-state {\n  text-align: center;\n  padding: 40px;\n  color: #94a3b8;\n}\n\n/* 底部 */\n.footer {\n  display: flex;\n  justify-content: space-between;\n  align-items: center;\n  padding-top: 16px;\n  border-top: 1px solid #e2e8f0;\n  font-size: 13px;\n}\n\n.dark-mode .footer {\n  border-top-color: #334155;\n}\n\n.clear-all {\n  padding: 6px 12px;\n  background: #f1f5f9;\n  border: none;\n  border-radius: 8px;\n  cursor: pointer;\n  font-size: 12px;\n}\n\n.dark-mode .clear-all {\n  background: #334155;\n  color: #e2e8f0;\n}\n\n/* 响应式 */\n@media (max-width: 500px) {\n  .expense-tracker {\n    margin: 20px;\n    padding: 16px;\n  }\n  \n  .balance-card {\n    flex-direction: column;\n    gap: 12px;\n  }\n  \n  .add-form {\n    flex-direction: column;\n  }\n  \n  .add-form select,\n  .add-form input,\n  .add-form button {\n    width: 100%;\n  }\n}",

<template>
<div class="expense-tracker" class="{{isDarkMode ? 'dark-mode' : ''}}">
  <div class="header">
    <h2>💰 记账本</h2>
    <button class="theme-btn" on-click="toggleTheme">{{isDarkMode ? '☀️' : '🌙'}}</button>
  </div>

  <div class="balance-card">
    <div class="balance-item">
      <span class="balance-label">总收入</span>
      <span class="balance-value income">+¥{{totalIncome}}</span>
    </div>
    <div class="balance-item">
      <span class="balance-label">总支出</span>
      <span class="balance-value expense">-¥{{totalExpense}}</span>
    </div>
    <div class="balance-item">
      <span class="balance-label">结余</span>
      <span class="balance-value" class="{{balance >= 0 ? 'positive' : 'negative'}}">¥{{balance}}</span>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="add-form">
    <select value="{= newType =}">
      <option value="income">收入</option>
      <option value="expense">支出</option>
    </select>
    <input type="number" placeholder="金额" value="{= newAmount =}" on-keyup.enter="addRecord" />
    <input type="text" placeholder="分类" value="{= newCategory =}" on-keyup.enter="addRecord" />
    <button on-click="addRecord">添加</button>
  </div>

  <div class="filter-bar">
    <select value="{= filterType =}">
      <option value="all">全部</option>
      <option value="income">收入</option>
      <option value="expense">支出</option>
    </select>
    <select value="{= filterCategory =}">
      <option value="all">全部分类</option>
      <option s-for="cat in categories" trackby cat value="{{cat}}">{{cat}}</option>
    </select>
    <button class="clear-filter" s-if="hasFilter" on-click="clearFilter">清除</button>
  </div>

  <div class="chart-section" s-if="expenseByCategory.length > 0">
    <h3>支出分类统计</h3>
    <div class="chart-bars">
      <div class="chart-item" s-for="item in expenseByCategory" trackby item.category>
        <span class="chart-label">{{item.category}}</span>
        <div class="bar-container">
          <div class="bar" style="{{'width: ' + getBarWidth(item.amount) + '%'}}"></div>
          <span class="bar-value">¥{{item.amount}}</span>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="records-list">
    <div class="record-item" s-for="record in filteredRecords" trackby record.id class="{{record.type}}">
      <div class="record-info">
        <span class="record-category">{{record.category}}</span>
        <span class="record-date">{{formatDate(record.date)}}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="record-amount" class="{{record.type}}">{{record.type === 'income' ? '+' : '-'}}¥{{record.amount}}</div>
      <button class="delete-btn" on-click="deleteRecord(record.id)">删除</button>
    </div>
    <div class="empty-state" s-if="filteredRecords.length === 0">暂无记录，添加一笔吧</div>
  </div>

  <div class="footer" s-if="records.length > 0">
    <span>共{{filteredRecords.length}}条记录</span>
    <button class="clear-all" on-click="clearAll">清空全部</button>
  </div>
</template>

<script>
const san = require('san');
const DataTypes = san.DataTypes;

module.exports = san.defineComponent({
  name: 'ExpenseTracker',

  dataTypes: {
    isDarkMode: DataTypes.bool,
    records: DataTypes.array,
    newType: DataTypes.string,
    newAmount: DataTypes.string,
    newCategory: DataTypes.string,
    filterType: DataTypes.string,
    filterCategory: DataTypes.string
  },

  initData() {
    return {
      isDarkMode: false,
      records: [],
      newType: 'expense',
      newAmount: '',
      newCategory: '',
      filterType: 'all',
      filterCategory: 'all'
    };
  },

  inited() {
    this.loadFromLocal();
  },

  computed: {
    totalIncome() {
      return this.data.get('records')
        .filter(r => r.type === 'income')
        .reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.amount, 0);
    },

    totalExpense() {
      return this.data.get('records')
        .filter(r => r.type === 'expense')
        .reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.amount, 0);
    },

    balance() {
      return this.data.get('totalIncome') - this.data.get('totalExpense');
    },

    categories() {
      const records = this.data.get('records');
      const cats = [...new Set(records.map(r => r.category))];
      return cats.sort();
    },

    expenseByCategory() {
      const records = this.data.get('records');
      const categoryMap = new Map();
      records
        .filter(r => r.type === 'expense')
        .forEach(r => {
          const current = categoryMap.get(r.category) || 0;
          categoryMap.set(r.category, current + r.amount);
        });
      return Array.from(categoryMap.entries())
        .map(([category, amount]) => ({ category, amount }))
        .sort((a, b) => b.amount - a.amount);
    },

    maxExpenseAmount() {
      const expenseByCategory = this.data.get('expenseByCategory');
      if (expenseByCategory.length === 0) return 0;
      return Math.max(...expenseByCategory.map(item => item.amount));
    },

    filteredRecords() {
      let result = [...this.data.get('records')];

      if (this.data.get('filterType') !== 'all') {
        result = result.filter(r => r.type === this.data.get('filterType'));
      }

      if (this.data.get('filterCategory') !== 'all') {
        result = result.filter(r => r.category === this.data.get('filterCategory'));
      }

      return result.sort((a, b) => b.date - a.date);
    },

    hasFilter() {
      return this.data.get('filterType') !== 'all' || this.data.get('filterCategory') !== 'all';
    }
  },

  addRecord() {
    const amount = parseFloat(this.data.get('newAmount'));
    if (isNaN(amount) || amount <= 0) {
      alert('请输入有效的金额');
      return;
    }
    if (!this.data.get('newCategory').trim()) {
      alert('请输入分类');
      return;
    }

    const newRecord = {
      id: Date.now(),
      type: this.data.get('newType'),
      amount: amount,
      category: this.data.get('newCategory').trim(),
      date: Date.now()
    };

    const records = this.data.get('records');
    records.push(newRecord);
    this.data.set('records', records);

    this.data.set('newAmount', '');
    this.data.set('newCategory', '');
    this.saveToLocal();
  },

  deleteRecord(id) {
    const records = this.data.get('records').filter(r => r.id !== id);
    this.data.set('records', records);
    this.saveToLocal();
  },

  clearAll() {
    if (confirm('确定要清空所有记录吗？')) {
      this.data.set('records', []);
      this.saveToLocal();
    }
  },

  clearFilter() {
    this.data.set('filterType', 'all');
    this.data.set('filterCategory', 'all');
  },

  getBarWidth(amount) {
    const maxExpenseAmount = this.data.get('maxExpenseAmount');
    if (maxExpenseAmount === 0) return 0;
    return (amount / maxExpenseAmount) * 100;
  },

  formatDate(timestamp) {
    const date = new Date(timestamp);
    const now = new Date();
    const today = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());
    const yesterday = new Date(today - 86400000);

    if (timestamp >= today) {
      return `今天 ${date.getHours()}:${String(date.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
    } else if (timestamp >= yesterday) {
      return '昨天';
    } else {
      return `${date.getMonth() + 1}/${date.getDate()}`;
    }
  },

  toggleTheme() {
    this.data.set('isDarkMode', !this.data.get('isDarkMode'));
  },

  saveToLocal() {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('expense_records', JSON.stringify(this.data.get('records')));
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Failed to save to localStorage:', e);
    }
  },

  loadFromLocal() {
    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem('expense_records');
      if (saved) {
        try {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(saved);
          this.data.set('records', this.normalizeRecords(parsed));
        } catch (e) {
          this.data.set('records', this.getSampleRecords());
        }
      } else {
        this.data.set('records', this.getSampleRecords());
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Failed to load from localStorage:', e);
      this.data.set('records', this.getSampleRecords());
    }
  },

  normalizeRecords(records) {
    if (!Array.isArray(records)) {
      return this.getSampleRecords();
    }

    return records
      .map((record, index) => {
        if (!record || typeof record !== 'object') {
          return null;
        }

        const type = record.type === 'income' ? 'income' : (record.type === 'expense' ? 'expense' : null);
        const amount = Number(record.amount);
        const category = typeof record.category === 'string' ? record.category.trim() : '';
        const date = Number(record.date);
        const id = record.id != null ? record.id : Date.now() + index;

        if (!type || !Number.isFinite(amount) || amount <= 0 || !category || !Number.isFinite(date)) {
          return null;
        }

        return { id, type, amount, category, date };
      })
      .filter(Boolean);
  },

  getSampleRecords() {
    const now = Date.now();
    return [
      { id: 1, type: 'income', amount: 5000, category: '工资', date: now - 2 * 86400000 },

san_generation_contract.description: 约束大模型基于本 schema 生成 San 组件时必须满足的条件。
must_preserve: metadata.component_name 和根节点语义
template.dom_tree 的层级结构、节点顺序与语义角色
template.component_refs 中每个子组件的注册名和父子通信事件
binding_graph 中 data/props/computed 到模板节点的可见绑定
event_model 中每个 DOM 事件和自定义事件的触发时机与 payload
style_model 中动态类名、动态样式、scoped CSS 和关键视觉状态
script.options.lifecycle_hooks 中的副作用初始化与清理逻辑
script.options.data 中所有字段的默认值和外部初始化来源
quality_checks: template.component_refs 中每个子组件都在 script.components 或 san_registration 中有定义
binding_graph.edges 中每条 template 依赖都能在 script.options 中找到来源
event_model.dom_events 中每个 handler_name 都存在于 script.options.methods
event_model.custom_events 中每个 emit_points 都对应 method 中的 $emit 调用
style_model.dynamic_class_bindings 的 dependencies 都存在于 binding_graph.nodes
script.options.watch 中的 deep watcher 在 migration_hints 中被标记并给出替代策略
san_syntax_requirements: 输出完整的 .san 单文件组件，包含 <template>、<script>、<style> 三个代码块；若无样式也保留空 style 或显式说明无样式
脚本块显式引入 san：const san = require('san')，并使用 module.exports = san.defineComponent(...) 导出组件
props 使用 san.DataTypes 声明，与 script.options.props 一一对应；优先输出 DataTypes.number / string / bool / array / object
组件定义使用 san.defineComponent
组件名来自 metadata.component_name，并显式输出 name 字段
data 使用 initData 返回默认值，与 script.options.data 一一对应；不要在 initData 中直接依赖复杂运行时读取
当 data 字段来源于 props 或外部初始化时，优先在 inited/attached 中用 this.data.set 完成同步
模板中使用 s-if、s-for、on-event、value={= =}、checked={= =} 等 San 语法
状态访问统一使用 this.data.get() / this.data.set()
优先将 methods 直接定义在组件对象顶层，避免保留 Vue 风格的 methods: {} 包裹
子组件标签使用短横线命名
子组件在 components 中显式注册
样式块需尽量完整输出，优先复用 styles/style_model 中已有 class 与 css_rules 信息
定时器、timeout、外部监听等副作用在 attached/disposed 中管理
